# Copilot instructions

This repository is AI-agent-first.

Start at:
- AGENTS.md
- STATE.md

Before touching the sim or game docs:
- docs/LAWS.md

For adding a weapon trait / fighter skill / bot:
- docs/RECIPES.md

Treat docs/GAMES.md and docs/history/ as a grep-only design archive. Never read them whole.

The canonical game file is:
- previews/spinclash-preview.html

Do not split the canonical.
Do not run measure.mjs without the owner's explicit go.
Propose before writing code.
